Average at best
Mar 2018 • Couples
I believe this is the original restaurant, the other is some sort of landlord eviction issue. I was really looking forward to eating at this restaurant and to be honest it was really busy with local people. We had the soft shelled crab (250VND) It was served with salad but truthfully it was bland and uninteresting, the crab rice (150VND) was ok, but not worth the effort of the visit. The spring rolls were really good (Can't remember the price, maybe 60VND?) We saw the crab claw dish had 5 crab claws about (4cm each) (250VND) it was a tiny plate. We did not bother to order it, it looked miserably small. We ate the food at both restaurants, it was identical, does not matter which one you eat at. We won't be going back.

Must try!
Aug 2017 • Couples
This was one of the best meal we've had during our city break in Hi Chi Minh.
Not only because of the good review from TA that brought us there but a friend of mine who used to live there for a couple of years also mentioned about it. Well, it was a good decision to try.

We had order vermicelli stir fried with (full of) crab meat and it was excellent, while crab roll (really don't know what it's called) also had a nice taste with a hint of white pepper. Before stepped into the restaurant, we saw live soft shell crab and then ordered it to be stir fried with garlic, and it was nice again. The waitress also helped us to recharge our mobile phones which was great. 

All in all, it was one of the best meal in Ho Chi Minh and highly recommended for the crab lover!
